notes.title: Super Dungeon Boy 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31988228/268574fd42ec10ad62f70c894c2065df4f5ce90f.png[/img]

[b]Super Dungeon Boy 2[/b] is more challenging! A new version so special it will set your hands on fire and freeze your brain.

[h1]What were the improvements:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Easier to play. Accurate shot and accurate dash.
[*] 3 difficulty modes: Easy, Normal and ULTRA RAPID FIRE!
[*] Now you will be able to face bosses... they are furious.
[*] Challenging levels... and each with its own achievements.
[*] Humor, easter eggs and crazy ideas.
[*] Lots of secret areas to explore.
[/list]
[h3]Check out all the news on the store page:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/799540/Super_Dungeon_Boy_2/

notes.title: About the Launch
notes.content:
[b]Super Dungeon Boy: Mega Fire[/b] will be a game full of news and challenges. We are working hard to make the game beautiful, light, fun, diverse, challenging and engaging.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31988228/e902276fca3b8de635ce7f601f79459a79d52f7a.png[/img]
[list]
[*]New mechanics - New game mechanics have been added. Everything to make the game more diverse and fun.
[*]New Enemies - New Enemies have been added to make fighting more challenging.
[*]New abilities - Now you will count not only your bow and arrow, but with new abilities.
[*]Cutscenes - We want to add some cutscenes to better explain this new adventure.
[*]Stability and performance - All without impacting game performance. The game remains lightweight and runs even on older video cards.
[/list]
But for all this to happen we ask you to wait a few more days. The release was postponed to April, but that does not mean you will not be able to try out the news later this month. Because we are preparing a demo version to evaluate reviews and suggestions submitted by you.

Soon we will give more information about the demo version. Be sure to follow the news and send your suggestions.
